scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a dry R&B stadium concert with a strict clear-bag policy, [X] chooses an approved carrier for a visible phone and other permitted essentials while coordinating its transparent body, trim, or strap with a comfortable outfit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场天气干燥、执行严格透明包规定的 R&B 体育场演唱会前，[X]要为可见的手机和其他获准携带的必需品选择合规包具，同时让透明包身、包边或肩带与舒适的穿搭协调。
examples: using Clear for the policy-compliant body rather than disguising an opaque carrier as acceptable
using Black, Navy, Gray, or White on permitted trim when the bag should recede beside the outfit
using Red, Pink, Gold, or Silver on a permitted strap or tiny clutch when the bag should act as a controlled accent

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently starting to commute by public transport, [X] evaluates one named laptop backpack for daily use and wants its color to support a sleek professional appearance without making the bag feel generic or difficult to recognize among other commuters' belongings.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始乘公共交通通勤后，[X]正在评估一款有明确型号的笔记本电脑背包，希望颜色既能维持利落专业的观感，又不会让背包显得毫无个性、混在其他通勤者的物品中难以辨认。
examples: choosing Black, Gray, or Navy when understated office compatibility matters most
choosing Blue, Green, Red, or Purple when deliberate recognition and personal identity matter more
comparing Brown, Tan, or Beige as quieter alternatives without changing the backpack's load, comfort, or durability requirements

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For one backpack serving a two-week trip that includes hiking, [X] leaves color until capacity, harness fit, access, security, and budget have all passed inspection, then balances everyday wearability against easy recognition outdoors.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]要为包含徒步活动的两周旅行购买一只背包，只有在容量、背负贴合度、取物方式、安全性和预算都通过检查后，才把颜色作为最终选择，在日常耐看与户外易辨认之间权衡。
examples: using Blue, Green, Teal, or Aqua when the traveler wants a cool outdoor direction
using Orange, Yellow, Red, or Coral when easier visual recognition is worth a brighter bag
using Black, Gray, Navy, Brown, or Olive when one backpack must also remain easy to wear away from the trail

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While studying business in Madrid, [X] compares named low-profile urban backpacks for carrying a costly laptop between classes and cafes, judging whether each color makes the carrier read like an ordinary lifestyle bag rather than conspicuous technology luggage.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在马德里读商科期间，[X]会在几款有明确品牌或型号的低调城市背包之间比较，用来在课堂与咖啡馆之间携带昂贵电脑，并判断不同颜色会让它更像普通生活背包，还是更像醒目的科技设备包。
examples: using Black, Gray, or Navy for the most restrained professional direction
using Brown, Tan, Beige, Khaki, or Olive when a softer everyday palette should reduce the technical look
using Burgundy, Maroon, or Wine when a muted color identity is preferred without turning the backpack into a bright focal point

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While assembling a Brock cosplay, [X] catches an inaccurate brown shoulder-bag recommendation and checks the chosen series depiction before selecting a blue or green backpack that preserves character accuracy while still carrying convention essentials.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在准备小刚角色扮演时，[X]发现“棕色单肩包”的建议并不准确，于是先核对所采用的动画版本，再选择蓝色或绿色背包，在维持角色还原度的同时装下漫展必需品。
examples: using Blue when it matches the selected Brock reference
using Green when that is the backpack shown in the selected depiction
rejecting Brown for this portrayal after the user identifies it as the wrong accessory rather than treating every earth tone as interchangeable

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing a birthday gift for a mother, [X] considers a small backpack or tote that can carry essentials on her regular walks, fit her casual wardrobe, reflect her stated favorite color, and remain within a seventy-euro total budget.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为母亲准备生日礼物时，[X]考虑一只适合她日常散步携带随身物品的小背包或托特包；它既要融入母亲的休闲穿衣方式、体现她明确说过的喜爱颜色，也要控制在总计 70 欧元以内。
examples: prioritizing Purple because it is the recipient's stated favorite rather than an inferred stereotype
considering Lavender-leaning Pink only when the giver wants a softer version of the same preference
rejecting an otherwise practical bag when its color ignores the strongest personal cue available for the gift

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation, [X] completes a formal, glamorous outfit around a pink floral dress with green and lavender details and considers a compact clutch whose color supports the dress and metallic or pearl jewelry without competing with prominent chest ruffles.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为毕业场合准备造型时，[X]围绕带有绿色和薰衣草紫细节的粉色花卉连衣裙完善正式又华丽的搭配，并考虑一只小巧手拿包；包的颜色要衬托裙装以及金属或珍珠首饰，又不能与胸前醒目的荷叶边争抢视觉中心。
examples: using Beige, Ivory, Cream, or White when the clutch should quietly frame the floral dress
using Gold or Silver when the clutch should continue the chosen jewelry finish
using Pink, Purple, or Green only when it picks up one dress color without overwhelming the ruffles

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While setting the dress theme for an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five women, [X] includes a compact crossbody bag in the invitation examples and chooses colors that remain coherent with either a polished after-dark theme or a four-color group-photo code.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位女性参加的户外午宴制定着装主题时，[X]在邀请示例中加入小巧斜挎包；包的颜色需要与精致的夜间乡村俱乐部主题协调，或融入便于集体合影的四色着装规则。
examples: using Black with Gold or Silver accents for the polished after-dark direction
using Fuchsia, Orange, Red, or Green when the bag participates in the four-color group code
using White or Pink only when it remains legible beside the attendee's selected golf outfit

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After building a comfortable minimalist outfit, [X] reviews a pictured necklace-and-bag combination and decides whether the shown bag color belongs inside the neutral base or supplies the one controlled accent without making the full look feel busy.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在搭好一套舒适的极简穿搭后，[X]查看一组有图片的项链与包搭配，并判断图中包的颜色应归入中性色基底，还是承担唯一受控的亮色点缀，同时避免让整体显得杂乱。
examples: using Black, White, Gray, Navy, or Beige when the pictured bag should stay inside the outfit's neutral base
using Red, Pink, Blue, Yellow, or Green when the bag is deliberately the only color pop
rejecting an additional saturated bag color when the red cap or another accessory already supplies the accent

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing a hard-shell case for a two-week international trip, [X] factors the post-trip routine of wiping away dirt and stains into the color decision, comparing how readily different finishes reveal travel marks and how much visible maintenance is realistically acceptable.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为两周国际旅行挑选硬壳行李箱时，[X]把旅行结束后擦除污垢和污渍的维护流程纳入颜色决策，比较不同色面暴露旅途痕迹的程度，以及自己实际上愿意承担多少可见清洁工作。
examples: using Black, Brown, Navy, Burgundy, Maroon, or Wine when the owner wants many ordinary marks to draw less attention
using Gray, Khaki, Olive, Tan, or Beige when a mid-tone compromise makes inspection and upkeep manageable
using White, Ivory, Cream, Yellow, or another light finish when the owner accepts more visible wiping in exchange for that appearance
